for (y,x) in sorted(pts):

    c=np.array([[float(x) for x in l.split()[1:4]] for l in L[2:2+n]])

print(Pidx)
P1,P2=cs[Pidx[0]],cs[Pidx[1]]
d=Pd-(P1+P2)/2; d/=np.linalg.norm(d)
# in-plane axis
u=P2-P1; u=u-np.dot(u,d)*d; u/=np.linalg.norm(u)
M=Pd+2.08*d
# cht: double bond 5-6
A,B=cc[5],cc[6]
mid=(A+B)/2
ax=B-A; ax/=np.linalg.norm(ax)
